name: PipelinePacker
description: Run a Packer command to build machine images on Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, vSphere, and local builders.
author: sethbacon

inputs.name: command
inputs.label: Command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Packer command to run.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory in which to run Packer. Defaults to the repository root.

inputs.name: templatePath
inputs.label: Template path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the Packer template file or directory (HCL2). Defaults to the current directory.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: Provider
inputs.visibleRule: command = build || command = validate || command = console || command = custom
inputs.helpMarkDown: Which cloud's credentials to inject for this command. Choose 'none' for Docker, QEMU, VirtualBox, VMware, Hyper-V, or Vagrant builders.

inputs.name: environmentServiceNameAzureRM
inputs.label: Azure subscription
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure Resource Manager service connection. Workload Identity Federation is recommended.

inputs.name: environmentAzureRmOverrideSubscriptionID
inputs.label: Override subscription ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Override the subscription ID from the service connection.

inputs.name: environmentServiceNameAWS
inputs.label: AWS service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: AWS service connection (Pipeline AWS for Packer).

inputs.name: environmentAuthSchemeAWS
inputs.label: AWS authentication scheme
inputs.helpMarkDown: How to authenticate to AWS.

inputs.name: awsRegion
inputs.label: AWS region
inputs.helpMarkDown: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Falls back to the region on the service connection if blank.

inputs.name: awsRoleArn
inputs.label: AWS role ARN
inputs.helpMarkDown: ARN of the IAM role to assume via web identity (OIDC).

inputs.name: awsSessionName
inputs.label: AWS role session name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Session name for the assumed role. Leave blank to derive one from the job (`ado-packer-<TeamProject>-<BuildId>`). The session name is the human-readable half of CloudTrail's `userIdentity.arn` (`arn:aws:sts::<acct>:assumed-role/<Role>/<SessionName>`), so a per-run value is what lets an incident responder tell which pipeline and which run created a resource; it can also be constrained with an `sts:RoleSessionName` trust-policy condition. A value supplied here must match AWS's grammar: 2-64 characters from `[A-Za-z0-9_+=,.@-]`.

inputs.name: environmentServiceNameGCP
inputs.label: GCP service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: GCP service connection (Pipeline GCP for Packer).

inputs.name: environmentAuthSchemeGCP
inputs.label: GCP authentication scheme
inputs.helpMarkDown: How to authenticate to GCP.

inputs.name: gcpProjectNumber
inputs.label: GCP project number
inputs.helpMarkDown: GCP project number for the workload identity pool audience.

inputs.name: gcpWorkloadIdentityPoolId
inputs.label: GCP workload identity pool ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Workload identity pool ID.

inputs.name: gcpWorkloadIdentityProviderId
inputs.label: GCP workload identity provider ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Workload identity provider ID.

inputs.name: gcpServiceAccountEmail
inputs.label: GCP service account email
inputs.helpMarkDown: Service account to impersonate via WIF.

inputs.name: environmentServiceNameOCI
inputs.label: OCI service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: OCI service connection (Pipeline OCI for Packer). The connection fields are exposed to the template as PKR_VAR_oci_* variables.

inputs.name: environmentServiceNameVSphere
inputs.label: vSphere service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: vSphere/vCenter service connection (Pipeline vSphere for Packer). Exposed to the template as PKR_VAR_vsphere_* variables.

inputs.name: vsphereInsecureConnection
inputs.label: vSphere insecure connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sets PKR_VAR_vsphere_insecure_connection=true, which makes the vsphere-iso/vsphere-clone builders **skip vCenter TLS certificate validation**. The vSphere password is then sent to vCenter over an unverified connection and can be intercepted on-path. Use only on a trusted network with a self-signed lab certificate -- never in production. The task emits a warning whenever this is enabled.

inputs.name: variableFiles
inputs.label: Variable files
inputs.visibleRule: command = build || command = validate || command = custom
inputs.helpMarkDown: One -var-file path per line.

inputs.name: packerVariables
inputs.label: Variables
inputs.visibleRule: command = build || command = validate || command = custom
inputs.helpMarkDown: One key=value per line, passed as -var arguments. These values are echoed in cleartext in the build log — do not put secrets here. For sensitive values use secureVarsFile, or a PKR_VAR_* Packer variable sourced from a secret pipeline variable.

inputs.name: secureVarsFile
inputs.label: Secure variable file
inputs.visibleRule: command = build || command = validate || command = custom
inputs.helpMarkDown: A variable file from the Secure Files library, passed as -var-file. Every scalar string value in the file (JSON `.pkrvars.json` or quoted HCL `.pkrvars.hcl` literals) is registered with the build-log secret masker before packer runs, so a value packer echoes is redacted. Values shorter than 4 characters, and numeric/boolean values, are NOT masked; nor is the file's content protected from a template that deliberately writes it to an artifact.

inputs.name: environmentVariables
inputs.label: Environment variables
inputs.helpMarkDown: One key=value per line. Set as environment variables for the Packer process (e.g. builder-specific settings). These values are not masked in the build log — do not put secrets here. Use a secret pipeline variable (which the agent masks) or secureVarsFile instead.

inputs.name: upgradePlugins
inputs.label: Upgrade plugins
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run init with -upgrade to update installed plugins to the latest matching versions.

inputs.name: githubToken
inputs.label: GitHub API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Set PACKER_GITHUB_API_TOKEN to avoid GitHub rate limits when downloading plugins. This field is plain text, not a secret input type — do not put secrets directly in this field. Reference a pipeline secret variable instead, e.g. `$(myGithubTokenSecret)`. Pasting a raw token directly into this field stores it in plaintext in the pipeline definition, visible to anyone with read access.

inputs.name: syntaxOnly
inputs.label: Syntax only
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run validate with -syntax-only (no variable or builder evaluation).

inputs.name: onlyBuilds
inputs.label: Only builds
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated build names to include (-only).

inputs.name: exceptBuilds
inputs.label: Except builds
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma-separated build names to exclude (-except).

inputs.name: parallelBuilds
inputs.label: Parallel builds
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum number of builds to run in parallel (-parallel-builds).

inputs.name: onError
inputs.label: On error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Behavior when a build fails (-on-error).

inputs.name: force
inputs.label: Force
inputs.helpMarkDown: Force a builder to run when artifacts from a previous build prevent it (-force).

inputs.name: disableColor
inputs.label: Disable color output
inputs.helpMarkDown: Disable colorized output (-color=false).

inputs.name: manifestFile
inputs.label: Manifest file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Path to the manifest post-processor output. When set, the last build's artifact id is exposed as the 'artifactId' output variable.

inputs.name: fmtCheck
inputs.label: Check formatting
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run fmt with -check -diff; a formatting difference fails the task.

inputs.name: fmtWrite
inputs.label: Write formatting changes
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run fmt with -write=true to reformat files in place.

inputs.name: fmtRecursive
inputs.label: Recursive
inputs.helpMarkDown: Also format files in subdirectories (-recursive).

inputs.name: consoleExpression
inputs.label: Console expression
inputs.helpMarkDown: Expression to evaluate non-interactively (piped to packer console on stdin).

inputs.name: fixValidate
inputs.label: Validate after fix
inputs.helpMarkDown: When disabled, runs fix with -validate=false.

inputs.name: fixOutputFile
inputs.label: Fix output file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. Write the fixed template to this file instead of stdout.

inputs.name: hclOutputFile
inputs.label: HCL2 output file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Output file for the upgraded HCL2 template (-output-file).

inputs.name: withAnnotations
inputs.label: With annotations
inputs.helpMarkDown: Include helper annotations in the upgraded template (-with-annotations).

inputs.name: pluginsSubCommand
inputs.label: Plugins sub-command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The packer plugins sub-command to run.

inputs.name: pluginSource
inputs.label: Plugin source
inputs.helpMarkDown: Plugin source address, e.g. github.com/hashicorp/azure.

inputs.name: pluginVersion
inputs.label: Plugin version constraint
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional version constraint, e.g. ~> 2.0.

inputs.name: customCommand
inputs.label: Custom command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Packer sub-command to run (e.g. a future command not yet surfaced as a dedicated option).

inputs.name: commandOptions
inputs.label: Additional command options
inputs.helpMarkDown: Free-form additional arguments appended to the Packer command. These are echoed in cleartext in the build log — do not put secrets here.

outputVariables.name: artifactId
outputVariables.description: The last build's artifact id, parsed from the manifest post-processor output (when manifestFile is set).

outputVariables.name: manifestFilePath
outputVariables.description: The resolved path to the Packer manifest file (when manifestFile is set).

outputVariables.name: fixFilePath
outputVariables.description: The path to the fixed template file (when the fix command writes to a file).

messages.PackerToolNotFound: Packer was not found on the agent. Add the Pipeline Packer tool installer task before this task, or ensure packer is on the PATH.
messages.Error_FederatedTokenAcquisitionFailed: Failed to acquire federated token for the service connection.
